description:
This team is called Project Omniscope: the universe left clues. We found them.

Our mission is to decode the discoveries hidden in humanity's legacy of space exploration.
summary: Project Omniscope is a space exploration project that investigates old equipment left on the Moon, Mars, and in space. We explain how these machines helped scientists make important discoveries and expand our understanding of the universe. Our goal is to show that even equipment that has completed its mission can leave behind valuable scientific knowledge.
details: Project Omniscope is an interactive space exploration project that showcases old equipment left on the Moon, Mars, and in space, explaining how it worked and what scientists discovered through it. Our project aims to make space science easier and more interesting while inspiring people to learn more about the universe. We combined NASA research, storytelling, creative digital designs, and physical models to bring these forgotten missions back to life. We used Canva to create our website and presentation, along with physical materials to build our Moon and Mars models. Our project is creative because it connects past space missions with modern technology and presents scientific discoveries engagingly. Throughout development, we considered scientific accuracy, creativity, available resources, and making the information easy for everyone to understand.
